name: DC-to-AC inverter
summary: A DC/AC inverter converts a documented DC supply into an AC output.
description: A DC/AC inverter converts a documented DC supply into an AC output. The output waveform, voltage, frequency and operating mode belong in the equipment and control records.
readingNotes: Distinguish a standalone AC output from an inverter intended to follow a network.
